topic: Kahan compensated modulo-2pi phase accumulation vs float32 ULP stagnation
topic_zh: Kahan 补偿 + 2π 周期取模相位累加与单精度 Float32 ULP 吞没冻结对比
scope: Deterministic IEEE-754 binary32 (Math.fround) Kahan compensated summation with periodic modulo-2pi rebase near zero versus naive float32 accumulation at large base epoch 2^18 = 262,144.0 across 300 sub-ticks. No long-horizon video diffusion execution.

robustness.name: Sampled chronometer stations preserve sub-ULP phase increments without stagnation

good_fit: 24/7 digital-twin dashboards, shader wave oscillators, and particle emitters running for hours or days
Explaining why IEEE-754 float32 swallows any increment Delta < 0.5 * 2^(floor(log2(T)) - 23)
Wrapping periodic shader phase uniforms into [0, 2*pi) on the CPU with Kahan error compensation before GPU upload

not_for: Short 5-second one-shot UI transitions starting at t = 0 where float32 ULP is 1e-7

Hardware double-precision (float64) compute kernels where 53 mantissa bits never saturate within human lifetimes
